desc:
💥SGWG is a CHAOTIC shooter game with TONS of weapons and abilities! Become a pro and flex your skill on noobs, purchase emotes with tokens to dance on them! 

🔫 90+ Weapons with over 50k unique loadouts you can make yourself and 10 maps from the Squid Game universe! 

📃Rules: 
- NO Exploiting 
- NO Abusing bugs 
- Teaming is allowed 

💻 RECOMMEND TO PLAY ON PC! 

⚙️Basic controls: (PC) 
- Shift to sprint 
- LMB to use weapons 
- RMB to scope 
- "F" unlock cursor / emote 
- "G" lock cursor / close all GUI'S 
- "M" automatically open's menu 

🏡This game was inspired by Netflix show Squid Game and item asylum on Roblox 

🧑‍💻Solo dev 
🤝Contributors: Andrew_KnowsRBLX, PNY92 & worthycomp
